measurement: Installed valid portrait bitmaps on native rostered player-season entries, not unique people or verified identities/photographic dates.
disposition: Deferred by explicit user instruction while confirmed data corrections continue.
user_instruction: Proceed with the next confirmed data errors. Log the state of the images as we'll fix that later.
boundaries: Missing portraits are a permitted documented release gap, not proof that imagery is complete.
Counts include FIFA and inherited images, not exclusively real period photographs.
Existing images positively confirmed to depict the wrong person must still be corrected or removed with identity repairs.
Preserve existing source originals, credits, review decisions and usable installed portraits.
Future expansion should reuse the existing photographic/FIFA pipelines and place bulky originals and caches on the Pi when available.
